atomicity: Non-atomic sequential walk and reads. Concurrent creators/writers can change the tree at any time; presence and hashes apply only when observed. Stable metadata checks are not a lock or an atomic snapshot.

historic_input_lock.note: Historic author metadata, not a new nine-file lock; the previously documented contract hash mismatch is not repaired.

scope: All enumerated regular working-tree files (tracked, untracked, ignored, hidden), excluding only root .git metadata, this output directory, __pycache__ directories and .pyc/.pyo bytecode. No Git mutations; no Max calls.
